name: Joke Hub & Custom Options
description: A collection of customizable settings & Jokes!

enable-custom-death-sound.name: Enable Custom Death Sound
enable-custom-death-sound.description: Replaces the death sound with one of these below

custom-death-sound-choice.name: Death Sound Effect
custom-death-sound-choice.description: Choose which sound plays when you die

enable-custom-icon.name: Enable Custom Icon
enable-custom-icon.description: Replaces your icon with one of these below

custom-icon-choice.name: Custom Icon Image
custom-icon-choice.description: Choose which icon image to use.

screen-break.name: Screen Break
screen-break.description: Black out sections of the screen on death.

grid-cols.name: Grid Size
grid-cols.description: How many pieces your screen splits into.

fps-penalty.name: FPS Penalty
fps-penalty.description: Reduce FPS cap on each death.

fps-drop.name: FPS Drop Per Death
fps-drop.description: How many FPS to subtract each death.

gravity-drop.name: Gravity Drop Per Death
gravity-drop.description: How much gravity decreases per death.

enable-runaway-play.name: Play button is scared of you
